title: TX-path error logging mislabels policy rejections as corruption: lichen_l2_tx crash_info_store(CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION) for every negative lichen_link_tx return
description: Found by security codereview pass of project-LICHEN-worker6-wrxl (P3, pre-existing pattern; the new SCHC_ERR_INVALID_ENDPOINT=-15 from wrxl now flows through it). lichen/subsys/lichen/link/l2/lichen_l2_tx.c:154 calls crash_info_store(CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION, __LINE__, (uint32_t)(-ret)) for EVERY negative return from lichen_link_tx, so a legitimate caller-input policy rejection (e.g. -15 emission-policy) is persisted to flash as 'corruption code 15' - conflating caller-address errors with memory corruption and costing flash wear if a node repeatedly tries to send policy-invalid datagrams. Inputs are node-local so no remote trigger today. Also lichen_util.h lichen_link_strerror has no SCHC-code cases (logs 'unknown error'). Fix: classify SCHC_ERR_* (and other caller-input rejections) distinctly from CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION (e.g. a CRASH_STATE_REJECT that does not persist, or drop the crash_info call for -EINVAL-class codes), and consider teaching lichen_link_strerror the SCHC codes; keep fail-closed behavior unchanged (datagram still dropped).
